scope: Real local Go/PostgreSQL and Chrome, synthetic archives and CSV only; no live AI/Telegram

checks.name: Closed-week recap counts done/missed/unlogged independently and uses saved adjusted minutes
Day detail preserves zero sleep and separates imported duration from completed plan minutes
Rest, unmarked scheduled days and imported activity keep distinct accessible states
90-day selection keeps focus and opens a day older than the existing 30-day wellbeing window
Activity and wellbeing periods are independent
Calendar fits 320/390/768/1440px with 44px targets, internal scrolling and dark-theme CSS
Browsing, periods and details are read-only and cause no runtime errors
